note: Hand-picked hero cards, chosen in the hero picker (node scripts/build_hero_picker.mjs, then open tools/hero-picker/index.html from a checkout). Entries may be a SKU (CHK-JW07-16) or a card id (checklistHero-jw07-16). Order is the order they appear. An empty list means the wall picks for itself: measured colourfulness, one palette per card, a product in every one. "never" names cards that stay in the library and are kept off the wall whatever the mix asks for: a SKU, a card id, or an offer card's template id (app.js, scOffWall). 2026-11-19 (the owner, of the wall: "we need to show off our best of the best... not the same theme twice in 1 hero .. with different taglines", "why don't we have any of the video style ads on here that looked happier and more vibrant"): eighteen chosen by eye from the rebuilt ads and the full ad's own looks, one for every slot the platform's mix gives (iPhone 5, Mac 2, iPad 2, consoles 2, one each for Samsung, Pixel, gold, coins, Pokémon, cars and trading cards), every pair and headline once, no rebuilt family twice, one dark tile. scripts/hero_wall_check.mjs holds the wall to it. 2026-11-22: the owner approved the wall ("Approve the wall"). "pins" holds each pick in the pair it was approved in: a pick is drawn in its pin, its approved still is kept (scripts/build_hero_stills.mjs draws it again only with --redraw, or when its pin changes), and the wall opens it in that pair (app.js openHouseAd), so new colour pairs in the engine (which move every seed's draw) never recolour an approved wall.
